evidence.note: SwiftPFN is a streamlined tabular foundation model using a lightweight row-wise attention-only backbone (with gated attention stabilization and learnable register tokens) plus an adaptive layer-wise early-exit mechanism, matching TabPFN v2/TabICL accuracy on classification and regression while cutting inference compute.
evidence.title: SwiftPFN: Revisiting Row-Wise Attention–Only Tabular Foundation Models with Adaptive Early Exit
